{{Quote|In time for tea. Come join me.|[[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] to [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]|<ref name="Eminence">{{TCW|Eminence (episode)}}</ref>}}
'''Tea''' was a beverage consumed by members of many [[Species/Legends|species]] around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The process in which it was made was simple, involving the addition of certain exotic plant-leaves to boiling [[Water/Legends|water]], the heat of the water leaching the properties of the leaves, giving the tea flavor. Occasionally [[Milk/Legends|milk]] or [[Sugar/Legends|sugar]] were added, either to lessen the heat, or to curb the flavor slightly, or to sweeten it. Some found this unpleasant. [[Crumpet]]s were sometimes served with tea. Tea could also be paired with biscuits.<ref name="Star Wars 2013 9">[[Star Wars (2013) 9|''Star Wars'' (2013) 9]]</ref>

Tea was normally drank from a mug or [[Thermajug/Legends|thermajug]].

[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] were known to enjoy drinking tea.
